results.title: Delivery OTP: how it works (synthetic)
results.content: Some couriers send a delivery OTP that you read out to the delivery person only when the parcel is physically handed over and you were expecting it. The message does not ask for payment or a link click.

results.title: Signs of a parcel scam (synthetic)
results.content: Parcel scams ask for a small 'redelivery fee' through a link, or claim customs charges for a parcel you did not order. Check the tracking ID in the courier's official app.
